SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is humour important? 2. Which programmes on radio or television do you find amusing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: interacting with technology skills as learners use digital tools to record dramatized sections of the text.

● Creativity and imagination: making connections as learners identify and illustrate instances of monologue and humour.

Values:
Love is fostered as learners work together as they dramatize examples of humour and monologue found from print and non-print

sources.

Link to other subjects:
